title: fix(metadata-protocol): the delete heal never registers a picked holder of a name two packages hold
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_
Fixes #33832
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两个包同名的仪表板、报表(以及同类"按包寻址、但元数据服务按名字只存一份"的类型)在删除一条记录后,注册表自动修复不再把"最后注册的那个包"的内容塞进裸槽位。
- 为什么改:元数据服务对这些类型每个名字只留最后注册的一份,修复时拿它当基线等于在两个包之间"猜一个"(违反 ADR-0150 D3)。真实启动实测:删除后注册表的裸查找改答最后注册的包,列表里同一项出现两次;对外的读接口(裸读 409、按包读各自内容、列表接口)不受影响。
- 风险与回滚:只在注册表里有两个及以上持有包时跳过基线读取,单持有包照旧恢复;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts` 的 `readHealBaseline` 开头新增的判断,再看 `packages/objectql/src/protocol-registry-heal-packageless-refusal.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol-registry-heal-packageless-refusal.test.ts`(需先构建 metadata-protocol),预期 12 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Ruling: ADR-0150 D3 (a bare read never picks between holders) and epic ruling 6818436831, which says of this heal: "Nothing picks a holder and no baseline is registered. The next bare read is the 409 naming exactly the two holders." Seat ruling 6812637203 Q2 ruled the same footing: "the removed row's entry in the bare slot is retired and no baseline is registered."

`readHealBaseline` (the delete heal's tier 2) now returns a settled miss, before any service read, for a type that is addressed by `(package, name)` (`isPackageScopedType`) but is stored in the metadata service by name alone (outside `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`), when the registry holds the name for two or more packages (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, disabled packages counted). For those types the service keeps only the item registered last and answers it to a read naming any package or none, so its answer there is a pick. Tier 3 then retires only the removed row's own bare-slot entry (its verb refuses a packaged artifact). A name one package holds is read as before.

The types this reaches: `dashboard`, `report`, `page`, `app`, `book`, `analytics_cube`, `hook`, `job`, `sharing_rule`, `queue`, `assignment_rule`. Pinned: `dashboard` and `report`, the card's two.

No change to `protocol.ts`, to `applyRegistryWriteThrough`, to `restoreArtifactRegistryView`'s catch branch, to the objectql registry, or to any spec surface.

### The premise, measured on a real boot (H2 first)

A kernel booted from a compiled artifact with three package bodies (alpha and beta each ship `dashboard mix_dash` and `report mix_rep`; a third, `other`, ships neither), the way `createStandaloneStack` composes it (`MetadataPlugin`'s artifact door plus `AppPlugin` over the same bundle). Both registration orders, both kernel shapes (`environmentId: env_local` with DB hydration, and none), 8 boots, at `45dee177`. A scratch rig, not committed.

- **The card's exact shape does not form on a real boot.** Every boot registered both holders in composite slots (`com.qa.alpha:mix_dash`, `com.qa.beta:mix_dash`). The metadata service kept only the body registered last, and answered it both bare and for `other`.
- **The pick does form.** `PUT` of `dashboard mix_dash` naming `other` was accepted (row stored, bound to `other`, kept out of the bare slot). Its delete answered `success: true`, logged nothing, and left the last-registered holder's body in the bare slot. After that `registry.getItem(type, name)` answered that holder (it answered the first-registered one before), and `registry.listItems(type)` listed that holder twice (3 entries for 2 holders). For `report` the save was refused (the rig's dataset did not exist), and the delete with no row still ran the heal and planted the same entry.
- **What did not move:** the protocol reads. The bare read was the 409 naming both holders, each holder's read served its own item, the read naming `other` was refused, and the protocol list showed each holder once, before and after. The composite slots answer them.

So the card's symptom (a holder's read refused naming the other) is unreachable on a real boot, while its mechanism (tier 2 registers a picked holder) reproduces there. This PR takes the fix route for the mechanism.

### FROM → TO

| Reading after the delete of a non-holder's row, two holders, either order | FROM (`45dee177`) | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Registry bare slot of the name | the last-registered holder's item | empty |
| `registry.listItems(type)` entries of the name | 3 (that holder twice) | 2 (each holder once) |
| `registry.getItem(type, name)` | the last-registered holder | the registry's first-composite fallback, as before the delete (follows from the empty bare slot; not re-read on the rig) |
| Protocol reads: bare / each holder / non-holder / list | 409 both / own / 409 / each once | unchanged |
| Heal log line | none | none |
| One holder (CONTROL) | that holder's baseline registered | unchanged |

`Clause-②: no`: no accepted or served answer of any door moves; only the registry's internal bare slot does.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/protocol-registry-heal-packageless-refusal.test.ts` (the shared real-registry heal harness), one new top-level describe on a real `SchemaRegistry` and a real `MetadataManager`, in the real boot's shape: each holder in its composite slot, the service keeping the last-registered one, the non-holder's stored row hydrated by `loadMetaFromDb` and kept out of the bare slot.

- `dashboard` and `report`, each in both registration orders: after `deleteMetaItem` naming the non-holder, the bare slot is empty, the registry lists each holder once, each holder's read serves its own item, the bare read is the 409 naming both holders in registration order, and the heal logs nothing.
- CONTROL, `dashboard` with one holder: the same delete still registers that holder's baseline in the bare slot.

**Ablation**, once, with the fix committed first. objectql pins resolve `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` through `dist/`, so each leg was rebuilt and preflighted.

- Mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the guard's `return` line replaced by a marker assignment (anchor 1 → 0, blob `5b888bd3` → `8f51c415`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` exit 0; `ablation-dist-preflight` exit 0 (marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`).
- Mutated run: **4 failed, 8 passed (12)**. All four two-holder cases failed at the bare-slot assertion: `expected 'shipped:com.acme.beta' to be undefined` (alpha first) and `expected 'shipped:com.acme.alpha' to be undefined` (beta first). The CONTROL and the 7 existing cases passed.
- Restore: blob back to `5b888bd3` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt (exit 0), `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0 (marker absent from all 24 built files, tree clean). Restored run: 12 passed (12).

## Acceptance notes

- The no-composite shape the card measured (holders only in the metadata service) does not form on a real boot: every real boot above registered both holders in composite slots. In that harness shape the service holds one item for the name (the other was overwritten), so the registry knows no second holder and this change does not move it. Recorded, not filed.
- A delete naming a package that stores no row of the name answered `success: true` and ran the heal (the `report` rig above). With this change it registers nothing for a two-holder name. Recorded for the seat, not filed.

## Verification
